segments.name: U.S. Concrete Pumping
segments.description: Provides operated concrete pumping services with skilled operators and specialized boom pump fleets to general and concrete contractors across U.S. construction projects.
segments.evidence: We provide operated concrete pumping services, for which customers are billed on a negotiated time and volume basis based on the duration of the job and yards of concrete pumped.

segments.name: U.S. Concrete Waste Management Services
segments.description: Collects, delivers and disposes of concrete washout using route-based pans and containers for U.S. construction sites and contractors.
segments.evidence: We charge a fixed fee that includes (1) the round-trip delivery and pickup of watertight pans / containers, (2) environmental disposal of concrete washout and (3) a specified number of days the pans / containers can be used for.

segments.name: U.K. Operations
products: rental of pumping equipment without an operator
segments.description: Provides operated concrete pumping and equipment rental without an operator, plus concrete waste management, to U.K. customers.
segments.evidence: Our concrete pumping services are primarily provided through either our Camfaud brand (operated pumping services) or our Premier Concrete Pumping brand (rental of pumping equipment without an operator).

revenueModel.text: Customers, mainly general contractors and concrete contractors, pay for operated concrete pumping billed on time and volume, and fixed fees for concrete washout pans.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customer base consists of general contractors or concrete contractors that span across the commercial, infrastructure and residential end markets.
